name: HaloApp sources
description: The Halo app (motion graphics): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/HaloApp, built from SuiteUI: the window, the Layer and Composition menus, the composition inspector (Pro density header, Composition rows and layer list), the viewer's status bar and timeline strip (scrub, select a layer, I and O set in and out points), the New Composition sheet, and the alert for a refused rename.
